name: vmstat
description: vmstat(1), the 2.11BSD port over sysctl(3) (apple/fgx#529).  Two lines of the default report -- the first since boot, the second the difference of two readings a second apart -- then -s's sums and -m's kernel memory tables.  The default header and both data lines prove the five leaves it reads (vm.cp_time, vm.sum, vm.meter, kern.boottime, kern.clockrate) answered: getleaf() exits with `cannot read' on any refusal.  A probe, not a gate test.
